issues.legal_issue: A government may include the establishment of a steel plant and allied industries within the statutory meaning of development of industries by notification.
material_facts: The governing statute defined development of industries to include specified projects and other schemes or projects notified by the State Government.
The State Government notified the steel plant and allied industries project as falling within that definition before acquiring land for it.
The land was acquired for establishment of the steel plant and allied and ancillary industries.
issues.conclusion: The steel plant and allied industries project fell within the statutory definition of development of industries, and the acquisition for that project was authorized.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 2(c) and 3(1) of the Orissa Development of Industries, Irrigation, Agriculture, Capital Construction and Resettlement of Displaced Persons (Land Acquisition) Act, 1948 permit the State Government to notify a scheme or project it considers appropriate for development of industries. A notified project need not be similar to the dams, reservoirs, or hydro-electric projects listed in the definition.

predicates.land_acquisition_challenge: The case is a challenge to a compulsory land acquisition for an asserted public purpose.
predicates.project_included_by_government_notificat: The government notified the project for which the land was acquired as falling within the statutory category of industrial development.

issues.definition: When an acquisition is challenged and the government has notified the project as industrial development, the acquisition is authorized as industrial development.

issues.legal_issue: Land acquired for an industrial undertaking may be used for a township that is a necessary adjunct to that undertaking.
material_facts: Land was acquired for a large steel plant and allied and ancillary industries.
Part of the acquired land was used for a civil township, including housing and civic facilities serving the plant and its employees.
issues.conclusion: Use of part of the acquired land for the civil township did not affect the validity of the acquisition.
issues.legal_principle: The purpose of acquiring land for a large industrial undertaking encompasses the residential quarters and civic amenities needed to support it. A township is a necessary adjunct and concomitant of a large steel plant.

predicates.land_acquisition_challenge: The case is a challenge to a compulsory land acquisition for an asserted public purpose.
predicates.land_acquired_for_industrial_undertaking: The land was acquired for an industrial undertaking.
predicates.township_supports_industrial_undertaking: Part of the acquired land was used for a township and facilities serving the industrial undertaking and its workforce.

issues.definition: When a challenged acquisition was for an industrial undertaking and the township supports that undertaking, township use does not invalidate the acquisition.

issues.legal_issue: A later transfer of acquired land for a related public purpose does not invalidate an otherwise valid compulsory acquisition.
material_facts: Land was acquired to expand railway facilities serving a steel plant.
Years after the acquisition, the railway authorities transferred part of the land to a local committee to provide a link road, bus and taxi stands, and shops around the railway station.
Those facilities served the railway station and were not extraneous to the purpose for which the land had been acquired.
issues.conclusion: The later transfer did not invalidate the acquisition because the land was not being used for a purpose extraneous to the original purpose.
issues.legal_principle: Under Gulam Mustafa & Ors. v. State of Maharashtra & Ors., a valid compulsory acquisition does not become void merely because the requiring authority later diverts the land to another public purpose. The Court applied that principle and found that the transfer here was not for an extraneous purpose.

predicates.land_acquisition_challenge: The case is a challenge to a compulsory land acquisition for an asserted public purpose.
predicates.post_acquisition_transfer: After the acquisition, the requiring authority transferred some of the acquired land to another public body.
predicates.transfer_serves_public_facilities_connec: The recipient used or planned to use the transferred land for public facilities connected to the purpose the acquisition served.

issues.definition: When a challenged acquisition is followed by a transfer for public facilities connected to the original purpose, the acquisition remains valid.

issues.legal_issue: A contention not raised before the High Court need not be considered for the first time in an appeal.
material_facts: In an appeal challenging a land acquisition, an appellant argued that possession of the land had not been taken.
The High Court's judgment showed that the appellant had not advanced that contention there.
issues.conclusion: The Court declined to permit the appellant to raise the possession contention for the first time on appeal.
issues.legal_principle: The Court would not permit a contention to be raised for the first time on appeal when it had not been advanced before the High Court.

predicates.land_acquisition_appeal: The case is an appeal challenging a land acquisition.
predicates.contention_not_raised_before_high_court: The appellant did not advance the contention before the High Court.

issues.definition: When an appellant in a land acquisition appeal did not raise a contention before the High Court, the contention is not considered for the first time on appeal.
